newsitem.title: POLAND: POLAND INVITES BIDS FOR EDIBLE-FATS COMPANY.
newsitem.headline: POLAND INVITES BIDS FOR EDIBLE-FATS COMPANY.

text.p: The newly founded Polish Treasury Ministry, the former privatisation ministry, is inviting bids for at least 10 percent of the edible-fats maker Zaklady Tluszczowe Kruszwica SA, the ministry said on Tuesday.
It said in a newspaper advertisement that 20 percent of the company's shares would be offered to employees and 20 percent to farmers and suppliers cooperating with Kruszwica.
The treasury will retain a five-percent stake for restitution claims.
The deadline for initial bids, to be placed with Business Analysts and Advisers Ltd, the ministry's adviser in the sale, is October 31.
Kruszwica, which employs 1,273, had a net profit of 15.6 million zlotys in 1995 on sales of 560.1 million zlotys.
